_doc: Semantic-Swingers LLMs4OL 2026 split composition: the record `id`s in each split used in the paper. Reconstruct full split files by joining these ids against the organizers' raw Task A/B release (build_splits.py). Contains NO benchmark text or gold — ids only. sha256_sorted_ids = sha256 of the newline-joined sorted ids (matches the team repo's verify_canonical_splits.py).
